task.description:
Write test specs (tests/specs/PAR-05.md, PAR-06.md, PIN-01.md, PIN-02.md) and any missing test code for this batch, now that Step 2a (implementation) and Step 2c (SECURITY-REVIEWER, PASS after one rework cycle on INV-1) are both complete and committed (commits 9ac7c2eb, 23eff3b2, 39d13534 on this branch).

SCOPE PER REQUIREMENT:
- PAR-05 (online partition conversion): FULL scope, all 5 ACs in docs/requirements.yaml (parent creation alongside live table, PartitionRangeGap on coverage gap, ON CONFLICT idempotent backfill, lock_timeout=3s swap with rollback-and-retry, ConversionRowCountMismatch + inverse rename, events_legacy retention). Implementation is in src/db/partition_conversion.zig.
- PAR-06 (time-bounded instance reconstruction): FULL scope, all 6 ACs (partition pruning via bounded predicate, cross-archive merge by sequence_num, ReconstructionWindowMissing repair-and-retry, last_event_at advanced in the append transaction, unbounded reconstruction refused, upper-bound +1 microsecond). Migration migrations/1150_par06_instance_projections_event_window.sql plus Store.append()/reconstructBounded() changes. NOTE: tests/integration/par06_instance_projections_event_window_test.zig already exists from Step 2a -- trace to it, do not duplicate; extend only if it does not already cover an AC.
- PIN-02 (pin set in INSTANCE_STARTED): FULL scope, all 5 ACs (pinned_versions[] shape incl. variable_schema entry, rollback-on-append-failure leaves no instance row, event log as sole record of record, zero-catalog/zero-module minimal case, source enum values). migrations/1151_pin02_instance_started_pinned_versions.sql plus the instance.zig call site.
- PIN-01: SCOPED ONLY to AC3 (VariableSchemaViolation on variable_schema mismatch), AC4 (UnresolvedPinOverride on pin_overrides naming a version that does not exist), and AC5 (pinned_versions[] deterministic ordering by kind then ref). Map these to the requirement body order in docs/requirements.yaml: AC1=UnresolvedCatalogRef (catalog, OUT OF SCOPE), AC2=UnresolvedModuleRef (module, OUT OF SCOPE), AC3=VariableSchemaViolation (IN SCOPE), AC4=UnresolvedPinOverride (IN SCOPE), AC5=deterministic ordering (IN SCOPE). Do NOT write or expect tests for AC1/AC2 -- these are explicitly out of scope for this batch, tracked as ISS-0672 / GH-306 (service_catalog has no version/status column; PLC-01 module catalog does not exist yet). The tests/specs/PIN-01.md spec file MUST state this scoping explicitly (which ACs are covered, which are deferred and why, with the ISS/GH reference) so TEST-DESIGN-VALIDATOR and RELEASE-VALIDATOR do not mistake the gap for an oversight. The 3 tenant-scoping regression tests in tests/integration/pin01_service_catalog_tenant_scope_test.zig already exist from the Step 2a SECURITY-REVIEWER rework (INV-1 fix, commit 23eff3b2) -- trace tests/specs/PIN-01.md to them for the tenant-isolation dimension of the AC1 resolution path (even though AC1 full catalog-version resolution is out of scope, the tenant-scoping of the lookup that DOES exist is in scope and already tested); do not duplicate this file.

Read .env directly for BPM_TEST_DB_URL -- do not hardcode ports; this host remaps db/db_test to non-default ports via a local docker-compose.override.yml.
acceptance_criteria: tests/specs/PAR-05.md, PAR-06.md, PIN-01.md, PIN-02.md all written per test_developer_guide.md format
PIN-01.md explicitly documents the AC1/AC2 out-of-scope decision with ISS-0672/GH-306 reference; does not silently omit them
Every MUST AC in scope (PAR-05 all 5, PAR-06 all 6, PIN-02 all 5, PIN-01 AC3/AC4/AC5) has at least one fully implemented, runnable integration test
No error.SkipZigTest on any in-scope MUST test
Existing tests (pin01_service_catalog_tenant_scope_test.zig, par06_instance_projections_event_window_test.zig) are traced to, not duplicated
All fixtures use per-test UUIDs; no shared/static fixture state; cleanup via defer even on failure
Spec test-case counts match implemented test counts exactly
python3 tools/lint_test_isolation.py tests/integration exits 0 with no BLOCKER
Fail-first confirmation recorded for every new/modified test
Any NEW incidental defect found is filed as its own ISS + GitHub issue and forwarded to the global queue per core-directives.md -- not fixed inline unless it genuinely blocks this step

result.summary: Wrote test specs (PAR-05.md, PAR-06.md, PIN-01.md, PIN-02.md) and test source for all four requirements. PIN-02 (5/5 tests pass) and PIN-01 AC5 ordering (2/2 pass) plus the 3 pre-existing REWORK 1 tenant-scope tests (3/3 pass) are fully green. PAR-05 (2/6 pass), PAR-06 reconstruction (3/5 pass), the pre-existing PAR-06 migration-slice file (1/3 pass), and PIN-01 AC3/AC4 (partial) are RED against real, newly-discovered production/test defects in the code this batch was implementing -- not against gaps in my own test design. Every test is fully implemented and runnable; the failures are genuine fail-first signal. Filed 5 new incidental issues (ISS-0676..ISS-0680 / GH-718..GH-722) covering: PAR-05 events_part missing its (event_id, created_at) unique constraint (blocks backfill/swap ON CONFLICT), PAR-06 InstanceStore.create() never populating first_event_at/last_event_at (12 raw INSERT call sites bypass Store.append()), a pre-existing schema-agnostic catalog-introspection bug in the existing PAR-06 migration test, PIN-01 validateVariableSchema() misusing registry.validatePayloadAgainstSchema() (rejects every conforming scalar variable), and a PinResolver.resolve() memory leak on error paths. All are BLOCKER/MAJOR, registered locally, filed on GitHub, and added to the global queue per the Issue Queue protocol -- none were fixed inline since they are BACKEND-DEV-scope production code changes outside TEST-DESIGNER write access. PIN-01 AC1/AC2 remain explicitly out of scope per ISS-0672/GH-306, documented in PIN-01.md. lint_test_isolation.py and lint_handoffs.py both exit 0.

issues.description: ISS-0676 / GH-718: PAR-05 partition_conversion.zig createParent() never adds the (event_id, created_at) unique constraint events_part needs for its own ON CONFLICT clauses -- blocks backfillOneMonth()/swap() against any real PostgreSQL.

ISS-0677 / GH-719: PAR-06 AC4 -- InstanceStore.create() (and 11 other raw INSERT INTO events call sites in instance.zig) never sets instance_projections.first_event_at/last_event_at; only Store.append() does.

ISS-0678 / GH-720: pre-existing par06_instance_projections_event_window_test.zig uses schema-agnostic information_schema/pg_indexes queries that match every accumulated tenant schema on the shared bpm_test container, not just tenant_default.

ISS-0679 / GH-721: PIN-01 AC3 -- validateVariableSchema() passes a single scalar field value to registry.validatePayloadAgainstSchema(), whose isJsonObject() guard requires a whole JSON object payload; every conforming scalar variable is incorrectly rejected as a violation.

ISS-0680 / GH-722: PIN-01 -- PinResolver.resolve() leaks allocator-owned PinnedVersion fields (resolved_id/version/ref) on every error return after Step 3 (VariableSchemaViolation, UnresolvedPinOverride, PoolExhausted, TransactionFailed).

result.next_action: Route to TEST-DESIGN-VALIDATOR (Step 3b) -- validator should confirm the RED tests correctly document ISS-0676..ISS-0680 as fail-first signal (not test-design gaps), and that ORCH schedules those 5 queued issues as their own WF-03 runs before this batch can reach TESTED/RELEASED.
